physics-killer-06.title: Karo da aminci, jifa a kwance da ƙarfin jan ƙasa
physics-killer-06.topic: Karo da aminci, jifa a kwance da ƙarfin jan ƙasa
physics-killer-06.goal: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.
physics-killer-06.material: A kan fili a kwance mara gogayya, abu A mai nauyin $2\,\mathrm{kg}$ yana motsi da gudun $6\,\mathrm{m/s}$, ya yi karo da abu B mai nauyin $4\,\mathrm{kg}$ da yake tsaye, sa'an nan abubuwan biyu su manne su yi motsi tare. Idan lokacin karo $0.05\,\mathrm{s}$ ne, wane zaɓi ne ya haɗa daidai, bi da bi, gudun abubuwan biyu nan da nan bayan karo, da girman matsakaicin ƙarfin da B ya samu a lokacin karo?
physics-killer-06.thinking.0: Karo da aminci, jifa a kwance da ƙarfin jan ƙasa
physics-killer-06.s.s1.prompt: A kan fili a kwance mara gogayya, abu A mai nauyin $2\,\mathrm{kg}$ yana motsi da gudun $6\,\mathrm{m/s}$, ya yi karo da abu B mai nauyin $4\,\mathrm{kg}$ da yake tsaye, sa'an nan abubuwan biyu su manne su yi motsi tare. Idan lokacin karo $0.05\,\mathrm{s}$ ne, wane zaɓi ne ya haɗa daidai, bi da bi, gudun abubuwan biyu nan da nan bayan karo, da girman matsakaicin ƙarfin da B ya samu a lokacin karo?
physics-killer-06.s.s1.explain: Kiyayewar motsi: $2\cdot6=(2+4)v\Rightarrow v=2\,\mathrm{m/s}$. Canjin motsin B $\Delta p_B=4\cdot2-0=8\,\mathrm{kg\cdot m/s}$, don haka $F_{avg}=\dfrac{8}{0.05}=160\,\mathrm{N}$. (Canjin motsin A $2(2-6)=-8$ yana da girma iri ɗaya, don haka sakamakon ya yi daidai.)
